payload.text:
Build a production-ready, high-end professional website for a beauty salon named Keza Glam Hub / Keza Beauty Salon, located in Kigali, Rwanda.

BRAND & STYLE

The brand should feel luxury, clean, modern, and trustworthy

Target audience: professional women, working clients, event clients

Visual style:

Clean white / nude / beige background

Elegant typography

Minimal, premium UI

Spacious layout (luxury feel)

Mobile-first and fast loading

WEBSITE STRUCTURE

Build the following pages:

1. Home

Hero section with:

“Keza Glam Hub / Keza Beauty Salon”

Tagline: “Professional Hair, Nails & Beauty Services in Kigali”

Primary CTA button: Book Appointment

Short “Why Choose Us” section

Featured services preview

Strong call-to-action to booking

2. Services (CMS-powered)

Services must be managed from an admin panel

Each service includes:

Service name

Short description

Optional price

“Book this service” button

3. Gallery

Clean image grid

Images managed from the admin panel

4. Book Appointment

Include two booking options:

Option A – Booking Form

Fields:

Full name

Phone number

Selected service

Preferred date & time

Notes

On submit:

Send form data to a configured Gmail address

Show a success confirmation message

Option B – WhatsApp Booking

Button that opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message, such as:
“Hello Keza Glam Hub, I would like to book a [service] on [date].”

5. Contact

Phone number

Email

WhatsApp button

Google Maps embed

ADMIN PANEL (VERY IMPORTANT)

Create a secure admin dashboard (CMS) that allows the salon owner to:

Add, edit, and delete services

Update prices and descriptions

Upload and manage gallery images

Edit text content (about section, contact info)

The admin panel must:

Be simple and non-technical

Require login (email + password)

Be suitable for non-developers

🔐 Admin Access Requirement

Add a clearly labeled “Admin Login” link in the FOOTER of the website

The admin login link must NOT be hidden or placed in a side menu

Footer should also include:

Salon name

Copyright

Contact details

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Production-ready code and structure

SEO-friendly

Secure (HTTPS)

Editable content via CMS

Forms integrated with Gmail

WhatsApp Click-to-Chat integration

Clean, maintainable architecture

FINAL EXPECTATION

The result should be a professional beauty salon website that:

Represents a premium brand

Makes booking easy

Gives full content control to the salon owner

Is suitable for real business use, not a demo

**Defining Project Scope**

Okay, I'm defining the project scope, nailing down the core features: Home, Services (CMS), Gallery (CMS), a Booking system (form and WhatsApp), Contact, and an Admin Panel. This website is for Keza Glam Hub in Kigali. I think I've got a solid framework in place now.


**Refining the Framework**

Okay, I've got a color palette (Soft Gold, Cream/Beige, and Charcoal), and I'm using luxury and modern styles, clean, and elegant typography. I have a technical setup with React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript and Lucide Icons. The project structure is now laid out: `metadata.json`, `index.html`, entry point, main router, TypeScript definitions, constants, and components/pages directories. I'm focusing on UI components and page structure, with CMS mocking in place.


**Detailing Component Implementation**

I'm now detailing component implementation, focusing on typography, admin authentication (simple localStorage email/password), and CMS state with localStorage persistence for services and gallery images to maintain the "production-ready" aspect. I'm working out the booking system, simulating Gmail integration with a mailto link or mock success, and WhatsApp integration with a constructed URI. I've also added Google Fonts to `index.html` and defined key types, along with constants. I'm shaping the Home, Services, and Gallery pages.
